Alger, 23 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 23, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Algérie Poste announced on Thursday that its mobile application BaridiMob has exceeded the threshold of six million subscribers. This growth comes in a context of expanding digital services by the public institution, despite recurrent technical disruptions reported by users.

L'établissement public Algérie Poste a c: The public institution Algérie Poste communicated the latest usage figures for its digital platforms on Thursday. The mobile payment application BaridiMob now has more than six million subscribers across the country, confirming the increase in digital usage within the postal network.
Parallèlement à cette hausse des inscrip: Alongside this increase in registrations, access and usage difficulties continue to be reported by some users. Algérie Poste admits that the application sometimes experiences technical disruptions that hinder its proper functioning. The company indicates that it is continuing its work to optimize software performance and expand the catalog of features offered. However, no specific details were provided regarding the exact nature of the outages or the concrete technical measures deployed to remedy them.
Le développement des outils informatique: The development of Algérie Poste's IT tools also concerns other platforms in the network. This is the case for the ECCP application, dedicated mainly to consulting data relating to postal current accounts, which currently has 12.47 million registered users.
Sur le volet monétique, l'établissement: On the electronic payment front, the public institution lists more than 18 million users holding the Edahabia card. This system relies on a hardware network deployed across the various regions of the country, including withdrawal equipment and payment terminals.
Afin de soutenir cette croissance, Algér: To support this growth, Algérie Poste intends to maintain its investments in its IT infrastructure and develop its electronic payment solutions. The main challenge for the operator lies in the ability to support the increase in the number of users through a constant improvement in the availability and reliability of services.
